summary: An employer carrying on business in Tanzania must register itself with the Director-General of the Fund, within the prescribed period and in the prescribed form, and give the prescribed particulars of its business. The particulars must be furnished separately for each business the employer carries on.

deliverable: Registration of the employer with the Director-General of the Fund
penalty: A fine not exceeding fifty million shillings or imprisonment for a term not exceeding five years or both

title: Pay the first month's compensation for an employee injured at work
summary: For an employee in its service at the time of an accident, the employer is liable to pay the compensation for temporary total disablement (calculated on 70 percent of the employee's monthly earnings) for the first month from the date of the accident; the Director-General then refunds it.
applies_when: When Employees at least 1
deliverable: Payment of the first month's compensation to the employee; refunded by the Director-General after the first month
penalty: A fine not exceeding ten million or imprisonment for a term not exceeding seven years

title: Present your trade weights and instruments for verification and stamping
summary: Weights, measures, measuring instruments and measuring systems used or intended for trade must be produced to an inspector for verification and stamping, with the prescribed fee paid, and may only be used in trade if they are of a pattern approved by the Commissioner, bear their denomination stamped legibly and carry a valid verification stamp. A stamped instrument that is removed, dismantled and re-installed must be re-tested and re-stamped before it is used again.

deliverable: A verification stamp on the weight, measure, measuring instrument or measuring system

validity.text: The verification stamp must be of a date not earlier than one year previous to the use, sale or exposure or possession for sale of the instrument

penalty: Contravening the verification provisions is an offence, punishable on a first conviction by a fine of not less than 300,000 shillings and not exceeding 50,000,000 shillings or up to two years' imprisonment, or both; an instrument without a valid stamp is liable to be forfeited.

title: Sell, pack and deliver goods only in the weight, measure and denomination permitted
summary: You must not sell, offer, import, pack, deliver, expose, keep on trade premises, carry or advertise goods for sale otherwise than in accordance with the weight or measure and the denomination specified under the Act, and pre-packed goods you own or hire to transport must be packaged in the manner specified by the Act.
